self_label: FinTFM with a trained linear readout
bar_text: RandomForest (default), at 1,000 Elo, is the bar for resubmitting to TabArena (design review DR7.6, owner decision 2026-11-13). The entry is 9.8 Elo above it, well inside the Elo interval of about ±90 (FINDINGS §290).
entry_text: It is not the zero-shot model. A linear model (logistic regression for classification, ridge or random-Fourier-feature ridge for regression) is fitted on the network's representation of each training split, one per partition leaf, and also takes the row's own features. Size-gated levers: four readout bags and spline features for small binary tables, one-hot indicators for multiclass, a random-Fourier-feature readout for small regression tables (FINDINGS §283, §286, §290). The binary, multiclass and regression checkpoints are all public under Apache-2.0 (fintfm 0.12.0). The figures are assembled from stored runs; a reproduction from the pull-request branch with no environment overrides is running. These are general-tabular results, not credit results: on real credit panels FinTFM currently loses to gradient boosting (FINDINGS §216).
types_note: Each figure comes from a leaderboard over that problem type's datasets only, so the four are not on one scale with each other or with the headline.
